other_failure_modes.name: Invalid SVD application in cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: The dimensionality reduction (SVD) is fitted on the validation fold instead of the training fold. This results in SVD components that are unaligned across folds, creating meaningless meta-features for the second-stage model.

other_failure_modes.name: Test data leakage via frequency encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical frequency encoding is computed on the concatenated train and test sets, leaking the test set distribution into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent hardcodes the submission IDs as a sequential range instead of preserving the original ID column from the test set, which will likely cause the submission to fail evaluation.

summary: The agent implements a sophisticated stacking pipeline with textual, temporal, and categorical features, but introduces a critical flaw by fitting SVD on validation folds rather than training folds. Additionally, there is test-set leakage through global frequency encoding, and temporal ordering is ignored during cross-validation. Finally, the hardcoded submission IDs will likely prevent the solution from being scored.
